changelog:
Getting ready for Google Play: clearer words about what the app is, and a privacy policy.

WHAT CHANGED

- The welcome screen and the Add source screen now say that MobileIPTV includes no channels or content, and that you are responsible for the sources you add.
- When you add a source whose address starts with http, the Add source screen tells you the connection is not encrypted, so your username and password are sent in plain text. You can still add it.
- Settings, App has a Privacy policy link.
- When every source is turned off, the message now points you to More, then Sources, where they moved in the last update.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Safe mode stays as you set it. In the version for Google Play, Safe mode starts on for new installs.

NOT YET

- The app is not on Google Play yet. This update prepares for a private test there.
